title: Postdoctoral Fellowships at ETH Zurich
field: Natural and technical sciences, biomedicine, biotechnology (interdisciplinary; human health or sustainability)
level: Postdoctoral (PhD within five years of start)

compensation.value: Up to DKK 3.6 million per fellowship (approximately up to DKK 1.2 million per year)
compensation.evidence_quote: NNF will support approximately up to DKK 1.2 million per year, with a maximum of DKK 3.6 million per fellowship

about: Novo Nordisk Foundation three-year postdoctoral fellowship: two years on a research project at ETH Zurich, then a return year at a Danish institution, funded up to DKK 3.6 million. The 2027 call opened 30 September 2026 and closes 29 January 2027, 2:00pm Copenhagen time.
requirements: PhD in natural or technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology obtained within five years of the start date
PhD students may apply if their supervisor confirms graduation before the start date
Danish host institution that employs the fellow and administers the grant
Interdisciplinary project with potential impact on human health or sustainability

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Interdisciplinary project with potential impact on human health or sustainability" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"PhD in natural or technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology obtained within five years of the start date" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
